title: studio(new package/object): package id is not derived or validated client-side, namespace is immutable and hidden, object identifier preview omits the prefix
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio → *New package (writable base)*: Package ID accepts `Repairs Center`; Create package sends it and the server answers 400.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Package ID is neither derived from Display name nor validated client-side (the landing's inline Duplicate form already uses `PackageIdInput` with `PACKAGE_ID_RE`; the New Package dialog does not).
- Namespace is derived from the id, but is read-only after create even when the package has no objects; the package sheet never shows it, though every object name carries it.
- *New object* previews the identifier as `repair_ticket`; the object is created as `repairs_repair_ticket`.
- Version (SemVer) and Type are required fields on the first screen.

## Expected

Name → derived id and namespace; invalid ids caught in the dialog; namespace editable while the package is empty and visible in the sheet; the identifier preview shows the real (prefixed) name; version/type under Advanced.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Reuse `PackageIdInput` in `PackageFormDialog`, derive `com.<org>.<slug>` from the name, show the prefixed preview in `CreateItemDialog`.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *new package id derive validate namespace immutable identifier prefix preview*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#2349 (closed) — closed 2026-07-15 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#2524): delivered a namespace field derived from the package id, editable + validated, and new-object auto-prefix. this card reads as a regression of that delivery
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
